stem: Rohan's grandfather in Lucknow has been diagnosed with type 2 diabetes. His doctor explains that this non-communicable disease cannot be cured in a few days, but it can be controlled. Which approach will best control his condition?

options.text: Taking one full course of medicine so that no further care is needed
Reducing physical activity so that the risk of heart disease also falls
Keeping him away from other family members for a few days
Managing the condition with regular medicine, a balanced diet, exercise and continuous checkups

teacher.key_rationale: Non-communicable diseases like diabetes are linked to lifestyle, diet and environment; control requires ongoing management through medication, lifestyle change and continuous care, not one-time treatment, isolation, or reduced activity.
